verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents restricting cards by category, merchant, or amount, or automatically locking or declining out-of-policy spend at the point of sale. Viewing card status through MCP, querying flag/decline reasons, and generic policy and approval workflows are related features, not this capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can restrict cards by category, merchant, and amount — and the platform auto-locks or declines out-of-policy spend at the point of sale
